findings.text: follow-on: the sentence says the full-map forward-mode column matches the basis central difference "to at most 3.2e-7 relative" over cells 8, 18, 80, 227, 242, 247, 522 and 529, but the basis column probe (column_probe_diverted_550.json) probed only cells 8, 80, 227, 242 and 522 and its worst full-map column relative disagreement is 1.96e-5 at cell 8 block 2 h=1e-5 (3.17e-7 is that receipt's second-worst entry), so both the cell set and the bound overstate the measurement.

follow-on: the sentence says path_weight and membership are "the only" stages whose disagreement exceeds 1e-4 relative "at that iterate" and every other stage "agrees to roundoff", but the receipt (column_probe_diverted_2000.json) shows root_position, bell_area, bell_moments, cut_moments and geometric_membership also exceeding 1e-4 at cells 1644, 1748 and 1750, so the claim holds only for the residual-dominating cells 40 and 50.

blocking: the node was dispatched to fix the diverted carrier's derivative at its owner and drive the 550 row to 1e-12, but the landed change is documentation only -- no fix, no committed diverted convergence test and no suite arms -- so it cannot land as the convergence deliverable the node names; the localization it does deliver is a valid partial evidence input and its own follow_ons already carry the remainder.
